name: System State display on the API page
description: The API page includes a System State field that shows the current state the system is in.

name: System Error Activity model
description: The System Error Activity model stores active errors after they have been resolved as archived error activity.

name: Hospital Station Stacklight
description: A stacklight at the Hospital Station indicates when a tote is present.

name: Device roster, mapping, and fleet membership state
description: The condition 'Device roster / map state' is defined to check for.

name: Disabled charger status as a logical allocation control
description: Disabling a charger does not shut down the charger hardware; it logically marks the charging location as unavailable for AGV allocation.

name: Overall System AGV Status page
description: A page titled "Overall System AGV Status" is presented as showing current status information.

name: AGV Present Indicator at Hospital Station
description: A flashing yellow stacklight for 15 seconds indicates that an AGV is present at either position of the hospital station.

name: UPS Chat / Stunnel message path health
description: The condition 'UPS Chat / Stunnel health' is defined to check for.

name: Ignition service status and service controls
description: The Ignition Gateway interface can show service-related status, and the training states that individual services are separate and can be restarted from the interface.

name: AGV fleet pause (soft stop) state
description: The condition 'RMS soft stop (pause)' is defined to check for.

name: AGV 'Hospital' Destination State
description: The 'Hospital' is an undesired AGV destination state during the 'Add AGV to Zone' recovery procedure. If an AGV is moving to the Hospital, it must be removed and re-added.

name: Success indication for robot add and remove actions
description: The system provides a success indication after robot add and remove actions.

name: WCS/OptiSweep API responsiveness state
description: The condition 'WCS / OptiSweep API responsiveness' is defined to check for.

name: Tote-robot association (pairing) state
description: The condition 'Tote-robot association state' is defined to check for.

name: AGV Green Lights Status
description: Green lights on an AGV indicate a ready or operational status after a power cycle, signaling that the AGV can be positioned over a QR code for localization.

name: System Status: Running
description: The 'Running' status is the normal operating state the system returns to after the close out (Bag Out) process is completed during start-up.

name: Sorter-side enablement and configuration
description: Sorter-side enablement is represented in the configuration data and can differ by implementation phase.

name: stunnel TLS connection status
description: The stunnel log displays TLS negotiation, session reuse, encryption, and connection status messages.

name: Lane Activity Status and Classification Labels
description: The displayed records contain status-like message and classification labels including “NewSort” and “SortConf.”

name: AGV status and E-stop models
description: OptiSweep receives AGV status and E-stop callbacks from GEEK and records related status information and timing metrics.
